editorialReview.problem: Separate write order from training-step identity without requiring a tracking SDK.

coverage.section1: Configuration, metadata header, integer steps, raw order and flush.
coverage.section2: Recursive merge, latest field wins, whole-array/null replacement, metadata omission and concrete step 10/8 example.
coverage.section3: NumPy/JAX/pandas conversion, DataFrame index loss, nonfinite null conversion, malformed-line errors, full-dataset memory and nested step metric.
coverage.section4: Final filename rule supersedes initial percent encoding, shared utility, preserved metadata, distinct suffixes, collision and overwrite implications, actionable small-run checks.

editorialReview.omissions: Unrelated public recorder utility exports omitted; not central to the local record story. No unexecuted tests presented as local verification.

image.content_prompt: Oblique archival desk: raw observation sheets retained in a ledger beside grouped indexed records. Matching crimson clips connect observations conceptually. No text or invented results. Metaphor for raw write preservation and read-time grouping.
image.style_prompt: Neutral white and gray, charcoal ink contours, local engraving texture, small crimson highlights; clean background, 16:9 crop-safe composition.

validation.languageConsistency: Full paragraph and section alignment; identical technical tokens and source links; regional Chinese and Portuguese variants reviewed.
